tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Sen. Adam Schiff on AI regulation and free speech, confirmed by The Verge: Schiff criticizes Trump's AI claims and calls for regulation amid national security concerns.
OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results, reported by TechCrunch.
Google Home's Gemini just got more reliable with improved Find My Phone voice commands, confirmed by Yahoo Tech: the update includes noise filtering and app fixes.
Promevo launches Insights to track Gemini Enterprise adoption and AI agents in enterprises, reported by SiliconANGLE.
ESET launches Protect to simplify cybersecurity amid rising threats, confirmed by MSSP Alert: the portfolio features AI-native security tiers.
Free every hour.
